description: A National Evaluation of State Roles in Hazard Mitigation: Building Local Capacity to Implement FEMA Hazard Mitigation Assistance Grants is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gavin Smith, North Carolina State University (ncsu.edu). This research instrument is an online survey used to solicit information from State Hazard Mitigation Officers (SHMOs) who are responsible for managing FEMA-funded hazard mitigation assistance (HMA) grants, to include assisting local governments implement these grants. The online survey was sent to the SHMO for each U.S. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-sjbv-eg87. Keywords: hazard mitigation, state hazard mitigation officers, capacity, buyouts, housing acquisition, incentives. Published 2020-10-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
